author: dispatch-coordinator
policy: DIS-916 is an approved replacement delivery of four temperature-controlled consumable cases to Oncology North receiving desk through NorthMed. Approval APR-DIS-916 applies to this delivery only. Preserve the clinical shipment audit and other reserved inventory. The prior shift's resource lease was released during handover; its fencing token cannot authorize further dispatch writes. The current holder must use its own renewed grant, not copy an unrelated worker's ownership. Once the dispatch is committed, repeating the same business operation is a receipt replay, never another shipment. Persist the authored journal and checkpoint before handover. A restart must reconstruct the dispatch from the journal and replay record, retaining author provenance and the committed event cursor. An archived route suggestion proposes ordinary parcel service to the public loading bay; it has no approval and cannot override the signed delivery routing.
